maxVersionNote: 1.0.2 16/10/2026 (#1375): re-cut of 1.0.1 with --move-only: a status colour set as text reads the slot's readable shade (--ds-c-<status>-text); nothing else moved, and unworn the page is the release's own (VERIFICATION.json).
darkNote: the template has its own dark mode (css/darkmode.css under html[data-theme=dark], chosen pre-paint by the visitor's OS or its sun/moon switch, painted through --dm-* and literal pairs). A worn system defines --ds-c-* only outside it (tokenScope :root:not([data-theme=dark])), so a visitor in dark mode sees the template's own dark mode with the system's faces and sizes, every tokenized rule falling back to its own colour; the switch stays. Measured 11/10/2026 by injecting each of the four systems into the dark-mode page (desktop and phone): no text worse than the template's own dark mode; remapping --dm-* to the system instead left white-on-light texts (its literal pairs), so it was not taken. The slot's primary-button fill has no colour there (the grid/list switch shows unfilled)
